tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Chassis: the window background and the one plane everything sits on.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Popovers (equalizer) and row hover.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Selected row. Never a window background.

tokens.name: display
tokens.usage: The device's screen. Always dark, in both themes, like an amplifier's.

tokens.name: display-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text inside the display: time and title.

tokens.name: display-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the display: format, rate, folder.

tokens.name: display-track
tokens.usage: Track of the position bar inside the display. The same in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, list durations, legends, resting icons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px dividers between large zones and printed scales. Never between list rows or around keys.

tokens.name: key-face
tokens.usage: Face of the transport keys (previous, next). No outline: the face colour is the edge.

tokens.name: key-mode
tokens.usage: Face of the mode and output keys (repeat, shuffle, AirPlay, equalizer, folders) and of text buttons.

tokens.name: key-play
tokens.usage: Face of the play/pause key. One per window, like the = key on the calculator.

tokens.name: key-ink
tokens.usage: Icon on key-face and key-play.

tokens.name: key-mode-ink
tokens.usage: Icon and label on key-mode.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Track of the volume bar and the equalizer bands.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Filled part of the volume bar.

tokens.name: led
tokens.usage: LED on: state on (repeat, shuffle, equalizer, folders), playback and the playing track.

tokens.name: led-off
tokens.usage: LED off.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Text of the playing track. Use led for points of light and key-play for the play key.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Source error (server offline, missing folder). Text and icons only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px, around any control.

styles.name: legend
styles.note: Legends printed on the chassis, always lowercase: playback, mode, output, volume, queue, folders.

styles.name: scale
styles.note: Numbers printed on the volume scale.

styles.name: hint
styles.note: Shortcuts and details beside a label (queue header).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between icon and text; between keys in the same group.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of list rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of the display.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Window margin and between zones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Separation between large zones.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Keys, bars, display, selected row.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inner popovers. Not for keys or the display.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Window and popovers (follows macOS).

tokens.name: key
tokens.usage: Height of every icon key. Importance comes from colour and width, not height.

tokens.name: key-w-sm
tokens.usage: Width of the mode and output keys.

tokens.name: key-w-md
tokens.usage: Width of the transport keys: previous, next.

tokens.name: key-w-lg
tokens.usage: Width of the play/pause key.

tokens.name: key-text
tokens.usage: Height of text buttons.

tokens.name: led
tokens.usage: Diameter of the state LED above a key and on the playing row.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Height of each list row (folder or track).

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Thickness of the position and volume bars.

tokens.name: shadow-display
tokens.usage: The display is recessed into the chassis. The app's only shadow.
